balls.text: tries another almighty heave, thick outside edge bounces away towards third man for a single, so no boundary off the bat since 12.6 overs
goes for a massive slog, doesn't connect

the free-hit results in a dot ball, short one is bottom edged towards the keeper, Aaron wanted a single though Dinda didn't move, Saha lobbed the ball to Johnson, who should have run out Aaron, instead he underam flick sends the ball over the stumps
short of length ball, Aaron does what he has been doing virtually every ball of his innings, doesn't connect properly, as in most balls his innings, gets a single, but it's a no-ball
a single down the ground, not easy for the tailenders against the pact of Mitch
length ball on the pads, defended back towards the bowler
slower yorker, 123.3kph, was heading down the leg side, Starc had made a bit of room, but he couldn't get bat on that full one, off the pads and onto the stumps
mistimes a hoick over the bowler, Starc pushes for the second, his pace forces the fielder to throw long to the keeper's end, Varun Aaron has a run on his hands, he beats the throw by a few inches
thick outside edge sends the ball racing towards the third man boundary, Balaji does well to cut that off
slapped towards deep point for a single
full ball on the pads, and another four leg-byes as Starc misses
Starc wants to launch that over long-on but can't connect
full ball is driven towards long-off for a single
thick inside edge towards deep backward square leg
short ball outside off, Aaron charges out and swings, can't connect
mistimed as Starc lofts the ball, reaches long-on on the bounce for a single
Aaon swivelling with every shot, sends the ball towards deep midwicket
short of length ball on the pads, clipped towards deep midwicket for a single
charges out and slogs towards long-on for a single
driven towards extra cover, another dot ball
inside-edge on to the boot, the ball dribbles towards the bowler
full ball, thick inside edge as he drives to the left of the bwowler
on the pads, no bat involved as Starc looks to glance it, off the thigh pads for four leg byes
length ball, Aaron charges out and hits it towards extra cover
looking to tap it to the off side off the back foot, beaten
looks for a big swipe, thick bottom edge sends the ball towards long-on for a single, Aaron retains strike
short of length ball outside off, pokes at it and misses
length ball angling in towards middle, defended towards mid-on
short of length ball, defended off the front foot
short of length ball on leg stump, clipped to the leg side
full ball is pummelled by Starc, Rishi Dhawan fields at mid-off, no run
short of length ball outside off, defended to the off side for a single
length ball on the pads, tapped just behind square leg for a single
blocks this full delivery

bad ball, bad shot, and there's a wicket, a short ball that sits up for Yuvraj, who tries to slam it over deep midwicket, instead picks out the fielder there, Miller takes a simple catch, this is just the 15th over, and Yuvraj was the last remaining batsman
charges out and scythes that towards point, again can't place it past the fielder
length ball is driven towards the cover
inside edges it past square leg for two
short of length ball is mistimed towards cover, no run
on the pads, glided towards backward square leg for a single
shortish ball is pulled towards midwicket, can't time it properly but gets a single

length ball angling across, Albie goes for another powerful hit, thick inside edge and that crashes into the stumps, Balaji gets rid of another overseas batsman, he dismissed all four of them in the Sunrisers game
slapped towards point, doesn't beat the fielder
powerfully swept behind square leg by Yuvraj for four, don't think the man at deep backward square leg picked it up, late to react so he has no chance of cutting that off
poked towards point for a single
trademark Albie, a muscular slog sweep sends the ball miles into the air, gets enough distance on it as well, clearing the midwicket rope
a single towards mid-on
this one goes straight on, hit in line but that was missing leg, Maxwell appeals but is turned down
spun away as Morkel looked to drive that through the off side
uses the width to steer the ball towards third man for a single, RCB doing a good job of consolidating here after all those big wickets
slower short ball, helped along towards midwicket for a single
short and wide, slapped away towards deep point for a single
short of length ball on the pads, worked towards deep square leg for a single
full ball is squeezed out towards cover
defended towards the leg side

the luck not going Maxwell's way today, Albie was down the track, and unsure how to play the ball, jabs at it as he is cramped up, bottom edge past the leg stump, Maxwell clutches his head in frustration
spinning away outside off, slapped towards point
tapped towards cover for one more
gets forward and lashes it towards sweeper cover for a single
length ball on the pads, clipped towards deep midwicket
Maxwell's second over starts with a length ball that is driven towards long-off
blocked back towards the bowler to end the over
short of length ball on leg stump, tapped towards deep square leg, 122.6kph
length ball on the pads, cramped up and that is defended to the leg side
this one is guided down to third man by Albie Morkel

big wicket here, AB is gone to a short and wide ball, slaps that straight to backward point, he didn't try to power that one, guided perfectly towards the fielder, no threat in the delivery, AB has given it away
starts with a 126.3kph length ball on the pads, clipped behind square leg for a single
shortish ball, worked away behind square.
swept hard but straight to deep midwicket.
Another one goes with the angle, and AB is hurried into an ungainly defensive shot.
down the track, driven down the ground.
left-arm spinner to Yuvraj, length ball on middle-and-leg. There can only be one result. Swatted way over cow corner.
shortish ball, batsman goes back, goes with the arm, hurriedly knocks it into the off side.
slower ball, and Yuvraj drives away from his body, inside-edges past off stump, and it rolls through to the keeper.
Similar delivery, but a little more width, and AB gives himself room to hit it to the right of point.
Back of a length, angled in on off stump. Defended off the back foot towards the covers.
Slower ball. Yuvraj checks his shot, and chips it down to long-on.
angled across Yuvraj from wide of the crease, and Yuvraj swings freely and connects sweetly to send it hurtling through the covers.
back in his crease to a length ball on off stump. Looks to punch it away but doesn't pierce the off-side field.
Bunts a length ball into the off side, and both batsmen take off immediately.
Full, on off stump. AB plays a checked drive to long-off.
short again, but not that short, and Yuvraj swings it away behind square leg.
Short ball, finally. 145.2kph. Rises sharply, and Yuvraj sways out of the way, even though it's fairly wide of his body. Saha takes it high above his head.
Length ball just outside off. AB goes back, pushes it into the covers.
Wide, AB goes low and steers it to third man's right with an open bat-face.
Outside off, chopped to point. Didn't really time that.
Late and slight movement into the left-hander from off stump. Yuvraj's bat comes down quickly from that big wind-up, pats it into the off side.
Full and much straighter this time. AB drives it to mid-on's left.
Width, and AB comes forward, places it to the left of a diving cover.
Half edge, half steer down to third man off a length ball angled across Yuvraj.
Back of a length, on leg stump, and Yuvraj's wrists come into play as he whips it nicely off his hips in front of square.
Full slower ball outside off. AB shapes for a big shot, but decides to block in the end.
Into the blockhole on leg stump, and they scamper a single. Seemed to go off his boot,  but the umpire didn't signal leg-byes.
Drifts into Yuvraj's pads, and he tucks it away neatly past square leg.

Short, AB rises to his toes and punches it to point. Bailey throws, and AB is a little tardy getting to the bowler's end, but he would have been fine with that dive even if the throw had found its mark.
Shot. AB drives it crisply down the ground, against the angle, and it runs away to the long-on boundary.
Wide of off stump. AB lets it go.
Swing away from the left-hander, but wide enough for Yuvraj to let go comfortably.
He's gone! Identical delivery, Parthiv goes for a big on-the-up drive, edges through to Saha.
Shapes it away from the left-hander, who overbalances a little as he plays and misses.
Back of a length. Sandeep's maintaining a tight off-stump line. Parthiv defends down the ground.
Defended again, towards the off side. Slightly shorter.
Length ball on off stump, defended into the cover area.

Pokes tentatively at a length ball angled across him, and gets a thick edge through to the keeper. Takawale is out for a seven-ball duck. Umpires check for the no-ball. They seem to be looking at his back foot and the return crease. No problem.
Big swing at a ball angled across him, beaten.
Bouncer, Takawale ducks under it.
full and wide outside off, Takawale flashes and misses.
Tucks it away into the leg side. Bit of hesitation, and Bailey swoops from midwicket. Picks it up and underarms it in one motion. Would have been out if he had hit at the bowler's end.
length ball on off stump, shapes into the batsman, who defends carefully.
Outswing this time, and Takawale lets it go oiutside off stump.
LBW! Billy's given it! Bit more shape into the right-hander, and Kohli is struck on the front pad. It seemed to be heading down the leg side, and he had taken a pretty big stride out.
and he doesn't need any time to play himself in. Given some width, Kohli cuts hard, with a big flourish.
bowled! Gayle is down the track, but plays down the wrong line as the ball shapes away from him and beats his outside edge before crashing into off stump.
Length ball, on the pads, tucked away square on the leg side.
Another, this time over mid-on. The ball seems to hit the rope on the full, but the umpire's called for replays. Yup, it's six.
Down the track, big swing of those arms, clears long-off comfortably.
Tries to sweep, misses. Loud appeal for LBW, not given. It pitched on middle, hit him in front. Hmmm.
Full, on off stump, Gayle aims a big drive at it, and the ball slices off the outside half of his bat.
Defended solidly back to the bowler.
Outside edge past first slip. Full ball, aims a big drive at it.

five in five for Kings XI, they complete a perfect UAE leg, Dhawan hammers the shortish ball to the wide long-on boundary,  Vijay Mallya is deflated,  Bailey and Dhawan are overjoyed, Kings XI have now won eight in a row starting from last season, the longest streak in the IPL
high full toss, too high, Bailey guides it down towards third man for a single
length ball on off stump, thumped towards long-on for a single, four more to go
Dhawan looking to smear that through the leg side, connects well, but Gayle dives to his left to cut that off
full ball outside off, searching for the yorker, jammed towards the off side
starts with a really poor delivery, angling it down the leg side, fine leg in the ring, easy for Bailey to help along for four
length ball on off stump, pushed back towards the bowler
pitched up and outside off, driven towards long-off for one more, Kings XI playing this like it is the middle overs of an ODI
slower bouncer this time, pulled towards deep square for one more
another single, pushed towards long-on
slower, full ball on the pads, 101kph, driven towards long-on for one more, Kings XI know they don't need to do anything fancy here, and they aren't
short of length ball outside off, driven in front of point for a single
length ball outside off, driven towards long-off for a single, sensible cricket from Kings XI here
full ball on the pads, clipped towards square leg
driven towards long-off for a single
chopped towards backward point
full ball and that is driven towards cover for a single
length ball heading for middle and leg, driven inside-out towards extra cover
full and slanting in from round the wicket, whipped towards deep midwicket for a quick two
full and wide outside off, Dhawan plays and misses
pitched up and that is guided towards backward point for a single
solidly defended towards the off side

powerfully struck, but doesn't beat AB at cover point. AB doesn't collect the ball cleanly on the first attempt, recovers superbly and fires it in towards the non-striker's end, a direct hit and that was a wicket
shortish and wide, 142.4kph, bottom edge as Dhawan looks to scythe that through the off, bounces through towards the keeper, Parthiv dives to his right to collect that
short once more from Yuvraj, spinning down leg, helped along towards deep backward square leg
loopy fuller ball, driven firmly but straight at Kohli at short cover
short and wide once more from Yuvraj, guided towards deep point
defended off the front foot to the off side
cleverly done by R Dhawan, playing it very late there, outside off and that is glided past slip for four
a touch short from Yuvraj to start, spinning away, luckily for Yuvraj it is not put away, chopped towards sweeper cover
Straight, close to the blockhole, defended back to the bowler.
Short, not too much room outside off stump, but Dhawan slashes it away off the front foot and times it beautifully to send it screaming past third man haring to his right.
slower bouncer, beats the batsman who aims a hopeful pull at it.
Good angle, cramping the batsman for room. Defended off the back foot.
Not short enough for the pull, and Dhawan gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
Short, outside off, Bailey tries to pull but hits it off the bottom of his bat down to a diving mid-off.
Chahal gets another! Parthiv gets in the act again as Sehwag tries to cut a legbreak. Replays suggest there was no outside edge, though.
tossed up again, like that ball that had beaten Sehwag earlier, but he checks his shot this time and places it to the right of a wide-ish long-off.
swept down to deep backward square
Another googly, Bailey is struck on the pads way down the leg side.
lovely delivery. Googly tossed up outside off, and Miller follows it with his hands, trying to hit it square but only managing an outside edge to Parthiv, who takes a good sharp catch.
Full, on leg stump, chipped down to long-on.
Short again, but a bit more pace, and Miller is struck on the body as he tries to tuck it into the leg side.
Change of angle doesn't help too much. Drifts down the leg side, and Miller only has to help it along behind square.
Short again, pulled again, squarer this time. This is poor bowling from Albie.
Short, pulled away into the big gap to long on's left.
slower ball on leg stump, worked down to deep midwicket
Short, pulled straight to Gayle at square leg.
googly again, Miller doesn't pick it and gets a leading edge down to long off.
better length, Miller comes forward, defends.
Shorter, quicker, and Miller gives himself room to slap it in front of point.
More of a skidder this time, and Sehwag watchfully plays it into the off side with soft hands.
slow, flighted ball outside off. Sehwag goes for a big shot over cover, and is beaten by the turn.
driven to long off
ducks safely under the bouncer, Starc has a bit of a chirp and Sehwag says something as well.
Good ball, back of a length on middle and off, moves away a touch after pitching. Defended off the back foot.
Short, but not short enough. Miller checks his pull towards midwicket.
pushed straight to point off the front foot. Kohli has a shy at the bowler's end, but misses. Sehwag was in anyway.
Bit of an inside edge down to Yuvraj, who misfields at deep backward square leg as he tries to pick up with one hand.
better. Straight, denies Miller room, defended back to the bowler.
even wider down the leg side and Parthiv had no chance to collect it behind the stumps, gets a vital bit of webbing on it to stop it from running away to the boundary.
He was bowling wide outside off to the right-handers, and ends up bowling the same angle to the left-handed Miller.
comes forward and pushes down to long off. TIme for a time-out.
short again, and Sehwag pulls to long on.
beaten as he tries to cut a legbreak that turns quite sharply.
Sehwag shows how it's done, going deep in his crease and punching it wristily to long on.
Legbreak this time, but only a little bit of turn. Enough to get the inside edge as Miller prods forward.
Googly turning from middle to off. Miller didn't look too confident as he defended into the off side.
whoa. Sehwag ducks into a bouncer, and the ball bounces off his helmet and races away to the fine third-man boundary.
short, down the leg side, Sehwag misses with an attempted flick-sweep.
Steered behind point off the front foot.
Short, rising ball. Gets on his toes to defend, and keeps it down even though he wasn't really in control.
worked into the leg side off the back foot.
blockhole ball on leg stump. It looked like Sehwag was trying to jam his bat down to keep it out, but it morphed into a flick at the last moment and flew away to the square leg boundary.
Starc takes another! Maxwell pulls, but doesn't hit it too cleanly, and Starc has to run in from the ropes and dive forward to cup it inches from the ground.
skids on, inside edge runs away towards square leg.
Flicked once more, Yuvraj runs from long on, has to go past the ball to pick it up with his left hand, gives the batsmen enough time to run two. Kohli isn't happy.
fuller now, flighted. Maxwell misses the slog sweep but only a half-hearted lbw appeal. The ball was clearly headed down the leg side.
googly, short once again, flicked into the leg side.
short and wide, cut straight to the sweeper.
Short ball first up, flicked into the midwicket region.
Good short ball, rising towards the rib-cage. Sehwag jumps off his feet to keep it down.
What a catch! Mitchell Starc, running to his left from fine leg, takes it coolly in his stride, inches from the rope, as Saha plays a pick-up shot off a length ball on leg stump.
back and across, worked to square leg. Slightly slow getting to the bowler's end, but Chahal's throw missed. Direct hit would have done for him.
Short, slightly wide of off stump. Saha stays leg-side of the ball and chops down on it to place it behind point.
slips down the leg side. This seems to be contagious.
angling in, tight on off stump. Punched into the off side.
Defended off the back foot to point.
Stunning. Whips a back-of-a-length ball from outside off stump in front of midwicket.
walks across to a middle-stump ball and half-pulls, fine leg was in the circle.
Short and wide, steered away to third man.
Short, angling away, left alone.
He's gone! Leans back and tries to steer it to third man, ends up edging it to the keeper.
Played away behind square with an open face off the back foot.
Bouncer, well-directed, fizzes past Pujara as he tries to hook.
Length ball, shapes away a touch from off stump, defended into the off side.
Onto the batsman's hips, tucked away to deep backward square leg.
Full, wide, bit of shape away. Sehwag crouches low and places it past point for four. Lovely hands.
Back of a length, middle and off, Sehwag twirls his wrists to send it scurrying past midwicket.
Back of a length, on off stump, played straight to point with an open bat-face.
Short and wide. Pujara is a good cutter, but he misses out this time, grabs too eagerly at it and is beaten.
Low full-toss on off stump, pushed to deep cover.
Full and straight, pings a leaden-footed Sehwag on the base of his pads, but the inswing would have taken it down the leg side.
Full, outside off, shapes in slightly. Pujara leans into it and eases the ball into the covers.
Wide of off stump again. This seems to be a plan from Starc. Pujara lets it go.
Overcompensates. Short and wide, but Pujara's uppercut goes straight to third man, on the bounce.
What's happening here? Albie's just not got his direction going. Another one slides down the leg side.
Another leg-side ball. Pujara misses out this time, off his pad to Parthiv, who takes it well diving to his left.
Drifts onto the pads, Pujara whips it away with a lot of bottom hand, flies away to the left of fine leg.
Slower ball, slips well down the leg side.
Misfield at point as Sehwag punches one off the back foot. It's Kohli, and the ball slips through his legs.
Back of a length, on the pads, tucked away square on the leg side.
Shortish, wide-ish. Sehwag opens his face and guides it to the off-side sweeper.
Nice little push between point and cover, gets forward and opens his face a touch.
takes a couple of steps down the pitch, plays an inswinging delivery into the leg side with a straight bat.
another ball wide of off stump, left alone.
Once again, Pujara throws his hands at a wide ball without really getting across with his front foot. Beaten again.
bit of inward movement, Pujara defends into the off side off the back foot.
Length ball wide of off stump, angled across from left-arm over. Pujara pokes with no feet, beaten.
